offer: Refill Corner, a household cleaning-product refill shop (example)
target: Renters aged 25 to 55 living within a 15-minute walk of Market Street who buy cleaning products at the supermarket today
pitch: Refill station for laundry liquid, dish soap and all-purpose cleaner.
Bring your own bottle or buy a glass one for 3.00.
Laundry liquid: 6.50 per litre (about 25 washes). Dish soap: 3.20 per 500 ml.
Open Tuesday to Sunday, 9:00 to 19:00, at Market Street 14.
Your first refill is free when you bring a bottle.

behaviours.name: Weekly big shop
behaviours.description: Buys everything in one supermarket trip on Saturday.

behaviours.name: Eco-motivated
behaviours.description: Avoids plastic where it is easy, pays a little more for it.

behaviours.name: Price comparer
behaviours.description: Checks the unit price and buys store brands.

behaviours.name: Online orderer
behaviours.description: Gets household goods delivered with the groceries.

behaviours.name: Brand loyal
behaviours.description: Has used the same detergent for years.

objections: Store-brand detergent is cheaper per wash
I would forget to bring the bottle
Another stop on a separate trip
Does refill detergent clean as well?
Opening hours clash with my work
contexts: you walk past Market Street on the way to the tram
you work late twice a week
you do the laundry for four people
you share a flat and split household costs
you cycle everywhere and carry what fits in a pannier
